fields.conflict: She will not lie to comfort him, and cannot say the true thing either.
fields.goal: Marcus wants Eleanor to say the drowning was not his fault.
fields.name: INT. FARMHOUSE KITCHEN - NIGHT
fields.outcome: He gets a confession instead of absolution, and it is worse.

fields.alternatives_considered: Firelight — rejected as too warm for a rupture.
fields.description: sc 19 lit by a single practical.
fields.name: One lamp for the confession
fields.rationale: The scene is about what can be said in the dark.

fields.author: director
fields.content: One practical only in sc 12 — the stove lamp. If we add a second the room stops being a place she hides in.
fields.name: Kitchen practicals for the confession
